appliesWhen: UI, chrome, layout, or interaction edits in the IPad-Cursor app (tldraw + Pencil).

rules.text: Design for Apple Pencil and finger. Keep chrome out of the way of the tldraw drawing surface — do not fight ink, pan, or tool lock.
HUD, lasso menu, explorer handle, and other tap controls stay at least ~44×44 CSS px.
touch-action must not hijack canvas pan/zoom; only explicit chrome (file list, menus) may scroll.
Draw / lasso / scratch-out stay Pencil strokes on the draw tool — not tldraw’s stock eraser or Alt+select.
Home is a scratch board; do not turn it into a settings dump or steal its ink semantics.
Ignore Flash / 800×600; keep labeling, grouping, feedback, errors, IA, and testing.
